chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 0446: Ji Ning's Stealth Attack on the Youngflame Clan Lair
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning begins a methodical infiltration of the Youngflame clan's fortress, using the Eight-Nine Arcane Art and soul-searching to map their defenses before launching his assault.
og_title: The Art of the Stealth Assassin in Xianxia
og_description: Ji Ning begins a methodical infiltration, using the Eight-Nine Arcane Art and soul-searching to map the Youngflame clan's defenses.
twitter_description: Ji Ning switches from swords to strategy, infiltrating a million-year-old fortress one soul at a time.

lore_anchors.definition: A supreme divine ability granting immunity to many physical attacks and the power to transform, phase through walls, and infiltrate even the most heavily guarded places in the Three Realms, like the Heavenly Court.
The ability to project one's understanding of a Dao as a persistent field of influence that can suppress, control, or crush weaker cultivators.
The sixth major realm of Ki Refining, where a cultivator births a Primal (a solidified soul-entity), granting them powerful divine sense and the ability to create independent clones.
An invasive interrogation technique where a cultivator forcibly extracts memories from a victim's soul, often causing severe spiritual damage or death.
The standard manifestation of a Primal at the Primal Daoist stage, symbolizing the perfect coalescence of Yin and Yang, per Daoist internal alchemy.

A cultivator whose physical body was destroyed during the Tribulation, forcing them to survive as a soul-entity. They are immensely powerful but face periodic, progressively deadly Loose Immortal Tribulations.
A million-year-old Loose Immortal and a high-ranking elder of the Youngflame clan's Dongfu Commandery branch, known for his debauched lifestyle and fanatical loyalty.
